steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've arrived.
Thanks to your memory and the flickering flames along the way, you return to that initial abandoned camp.
Hestia steps forward, carefully identifying the surroundings with touch. Dry food, water, and some defensive gear. Up close, you see plenty of remaining items here.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...This was the expedition's last camp on the outside. They decided to enter the forbidden zone from here, and that's when I ran away.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: But when I left, everyone was packing up to move. How come there are still so many supplies left here...
Maybe they are meant for you.
You wanted to say, but seeing her expression now, you think that won't be necessary.
You'll let her reminisce a bit longer before you set off again. Just then, a familiar voice comes not far away from the darkness.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Chief!
Probably glimpsing the light, a figure limps over. It's the FAC captain.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: You finally came back. I almost went off to look for you. We could have missed each other.
Hearing the stranger's voice, Hestia grips your hand tightly, shrinking back behind you.
So this is what she looks like when meeting a stranger for the first time. You'll have to tease her later.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: She's...? Did she release these sparks?
He looks at Hestia, then at the strange sparks floating around her.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Is she a <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But she's a little timi... Ahem, a little cautious. Please take good care of her.
Hestia's hand pinches you behind your back. The soldier catches this small gesture.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: You two seem quite close, Chief.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Thank you, young lady. It was your little sparks that saved my life. Now it's my turn. Don't worry, I'll keep you safe.
He deliberately removes his helmet and leans down slightly toward the girl while keeping a reassuring distance, speaking gently.
Hestia looks at the stranger, then at you, hesitates for a moment, and finally reaches out to shake the soldier's hand before quickly retreating behind you.

You're certain the soldier indeed makes contact with the girl at that moment and doesn't notice anything unusual. He seems relieved to have gained trust, stands up straight, and resumes his solemn demeanor before posing the question.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: You're back from your investigation of the incident. You must have made some significant progress, right?

steps.speaker: Option
options: This girl was a member of the expedition.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Regardless of how she managed to appear before us, the current overlap of our spacetime brings us unprecedentedly close to certain key events back then.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The expedition is now venturing deep into the DisSea for the first time, approaching the Perishing Star. Perhaps they're walking toward death, or perhaps closer to the truth. For us, this is also a rare chance to approach the historical truth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, Captain, there's one thing I must ask of you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Take this girl, Hestia, out of the mutated area. Please ensure her safety at all costs.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Could she be...

steps.speaker: Option
options: She is the cause of the phenomenon.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This darkness is the materialization of Hestia's inner fear. Her staying here will only worsen the contamination. I need you to take her out of the mutated area, to a safe place.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Only when Hestia is completely at ease can this phenomenon possibly come to an end.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Of course, I will protect her. It's my duty. But Chief...
He must have seen through your thought and wants to stop you. In response, you reach out to him. In that instant, your hands pass through each other, surprising the soldier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's right. What you see now is merely a projection of my consciousness. You don't need to take me back or worry about my safety. We don't exist in the same dimension.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My body is at the MBCC, under strict supervision by Schorl from Paradeisos. If I encounter any danger or severe contamination, it will wake me to prevent harm. And as long as the phenomenon persists, my consciousness will be brought back here against my will time after time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's why I must act, and I am the best suited to do so.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The biggest help I most urgently need from you is to protect this girl and take her away.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: ...Understood. I will follow your orders.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Wait, I... don't understand what you're saying.
The girl interrupts your conversation, clutching your clothes tightly. She sounds more confused than uncertain, hoping you can help her understand the situation.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What do you mean by "take her away"? Where are you going then?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What Chief? What Sinner? Aren't you ${PlayerName}? Why are you talking like an adult?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Didn't we agree to get out and wait for everyone? You said this is not a job for the kids, that we should seek help from reliable adults...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not that <color=#fb9259>little guide</color> you know.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...What?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The little guide you know is with the expedition now, leading them deeper into the darkness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And I'm not a member of the expedition.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: But... the expedition... All those things you've told me, you...
She grabs the hem of your clothes, but struggles to reach your face. She can't figure out your height just from hearing your voice.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You're not... ${PlayerName}...?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: But the things you've said, and that earring... No way I can be mistaken, you...
Holding her shoulders, you pull away slightly, finding it so hard to do and say these things at this moment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...All these are mere illusions. The Illusory Moon creates these false images that lure and trap us with the desires in our hearts.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We must not be deceived by it. Remember our purpose and those who are truly important to us.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...No, liar.
The girl suddenly tenses up, her expression shifting from unease to anger.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Liar! You are abandoning me and running back to them, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to get you away from danger and fear. I want you to leave the DisSea safely.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I don't care!
Hestia grabs you, tears welling up again. It seems you always make her cry.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Don't go... We've just managed to escape. Just listen to me once, okay? Don't go back. Just don't go. You'll die...
By the end, the anger in her tone has vanished and she's almost pleading for you to stay.
You remain silent for a long while, then kneel before her on one knee. You remove your earring, guide her hand to touch your face, and then release the shackles at the slightest intensity.
Hestia trembles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Remember what you feel now, Hestia, this is who I am. An adult venturing deep into the darkness with a weapon to stop this phenomenon and follow the expedition.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not that friend of yours, but I respect and admire those you love just the same.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This time, you've shown me the way, one that leads unprecedentedly close to the truth. I don't want to waste it. Like you, I'm eager for them to return.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I can't take you further into it. I can't let you close to that fear again.
Hestia's eyes are fixed on you, as if those sightless eyes can suddenly see right through you. After a while, she smiles.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Scared, aren't you? You're afraid... Haha... I know it... You're lying...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You're scared to be with me... Every time we get close, you'll pull away... You're afraid to face me, I know...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Why? You don't hate me, so why? What are you really afraid of?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is just a <color=#fb9259>trap</color>.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: They are long dead. This is just a trap to stir up your emotions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just want to make it possible for you to finally leave the DisSea, this place imprisoning you.
You must stop talking to her. You look at the FAC captain, who either understands how you feel or is simply obeying orders. He holds her back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Keep her safe.
Hestia doesn't struggle this time. In front of the two of you, she seems to understand any resistance is useless. She simply clutches her torch tightly, her hollow eyes staring straight at you.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Heh... Liar...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I'm not leaving. This time, I won't run away no matter how scared I am. I'll stay here and wait for you.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...So you're not allowed to run away either.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Come back to me, coward... You must come back to me.
